# Docket Technical Specification

> **Notice**: Docket produces high-fidelity executive PDFs with zero content clipping.

## 1. Feature Matrix

| Feature | Support Level | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Margin Safety** | 100% Guaranteed | `@page { margin: 0; }` + internal padding |
| **OpenTUI** | Built-in | Text mode & File mode switcher |
| **Themes** | 5 Presets | Executive, Technical, Legal, Boardroom, Minimal |

## 2. Example Code Block

```typescript
import { renderPdf } from "./core/render";

const res = await renderPdf({
  markdownSource: "# Hello Docket",
  themeId: "executive",
  outputPath: "out.pdf",
});
```
